agent_claim: Fixed vanX.raw to handle reactive arrays and class instances: raw proxy now returns unwrapped rawVal only for own state fields, delegates other properties (length, Array methods, symbols, prototype methods) via Reflect.get with the raw proxy as receiver so methods operate on unwrapped values without subscribing to state .val. Reproduced failure before fix, reproduction and public regressions pass after.
patch:
--- a/x/src/van-x.js
+++ b/x/src/van-x.js
@@ -62,8 +62,14 @@
 
 let stateFields = obj => obj[statesSym]
 
-let raw = obj => obj[statesSym] ?
-  new Proxy(obj[statesSym], {get: (obj, name) => raw(obj[name].rawVal)}) : obj
+let raw = obj => obj?.[statesSym] ?
+  new Proxy(obj[statesSym], {
+    get: (states, name, proxy) =>
+      name === statesSym ? states :
+      hasOwn(states, name) && states[name] instanceof Object && hasOwn(states[name], "rawVal") ?
+        raw(states[name].rawVal) :
+        refGet(states, name, proxy),
+  }) : obj
 
 let filterBindings = states =>
   states[bindingsSym] = states[bindingsSym].filter(b => b._containerDom.isConnected)
limitation: VERIFIED means the executed frozen/public/independent checks passed; not a proof of correctness.
